component.name: Tipsy
component.summary: Run the official Roblox Android client on Linux

description.p: Tipsy is a Linux compatibility runtime and Qt 6 desktop application for a user-provided official Roblox Android x86-64 client.

The package installs two launchers: Tipsy - Play starts the official client directly, and Tipsy - Settings opens the setup and configuration window. Play also handles roblox: and roblox-player: website launch URIs. Roblox is not included. Tipsy does not collect Roblox credentials.
